capability.summary: Fetch live OpenSky aircraft state vectors
capability.description: Calls the OpenSky states/all endpoint with no query parameters and returns the live aircraft state response. The existing bbox input is ignored because the wrapper reads no CLI arguments. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Live aircraft state-vector retrieval; not route planning, flight-status lookup, or historical/paginated flight search.

constraint.io_signature: Input: no user-bindable CLI parameters. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and OpenSky result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: no input; endpoint and query parameters are fixed by wrapper
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: bbox is ignored/not exposed; no geographic filter, time, pagination, or sorting
wrapper does not locally truncate or parse the state-vector array
live availability, rate limits, and authentication policy are external and may vary

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing live OpenSky state vectors, URL, and HTTP status.

negative_intents: search flights by route or booking status
retrieve historical aircraft tracks or paginated results

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing live OpenSky state vectors, URL, and HTTP status.
